# Temple Scroll Column 49 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 49 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**49:1** When you lay siege to a city for an extended period to wage war against it and capture it, you shall not destroy its trees by swinging an axe against them.

**49:2** You may eat their fruit; you shall not fell them. For is the tree of the field a human being, that it should come under your siege?

**49:3** Only the tree that you know does not produce food — that you may destroy and cut down, and you shall construct siege works against the city.

**49:4** You shall carry a peg among your implements, and when you relieve yourself outside, you shall dig with it and then cover your waste.

**49:5** For the LORD your God walks in the midst of your encampment to deliver you and to hand your enemies over to you; therefore your camp shall be holy, lest he see any indecent matter among you and turn away from you.

**49:6** When you go out to war against your enemies and the LORD your God delivers them into your power, and you take captives —

**49:7** and you observe among the captives a woman of comely appearance, and you desire her and wish to take her as your wife —

**49:8** you shall bring her into your household. She shall shave her head and pare her nails.

**49:9** She shall remove her garment of captivity and shall remain in your household and mourn her father and her mother for one full month.

**49:10** After that you may consummate the marriage; you shall be her husband, and she shall be your wife.

**49:11** If it comes to pass that you find no pleasure in her, you shall release her to go wherever she wishes; you shall by no means sell her for silver.

**49:12** You shall not treat her as merchandise, because you have humiliated her.

**49:13** You shall not surrender to his master a slave who has fled from his master and sought refuge with you.

**49:14** He shall reside with you, in your midst, in whatever place he chooses within any of your towns, wherever suits him best. You shall not mistreat him.

**49:15** No woman among the daughters of Israel shall serve as a cult devotee, and no man among the sons of Israel shall serve as a cult devotee.

**49:16** You shall not bring the earnings of a harlot or the wages of a male prostitute into the house of the LORD your God in payment of any vow, for both are detestable to the LORD your God.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 49 combines siege regulations (Deuteronomy 20:19-20; 23:12-14), the captive woman provision (Deuteronomy 21:10-14), the fugitive slave law (Deuteronomy 23:15-16), and the cult prostitution prohibition (Deuteronomy 23:17-18). LOGOS renders qedeshah/qadesh as "cult devotee" to capture the religious dimension while avoiding ambiguity. "Price of a dog" is rendered as "wages of a male prostitute" for clarity.*
